name: Phone ship service (Mac launchd agent)
purpose: the ONE shipper to the phone (tools/phone/ship.sh run, from the $POWOS_RUN_ROOT/ship-runner checkout, default ~/pw/ship-runner) as the launchd agent com.powos.ship-runner: agents push to origin and `ship.sh request`; it waits for 60 s without a new origin commit, then ships origin's tip once - ship-apk.sh when Kotlin/APK inputs changed since the installed build, else shell/push.sh of the shell files that differ from what's live - with every request's note in one notification. Kicked by request (launchctl kickstart), restarted if it dies (KeepAlive), exits by itself when nothing is requested
unbounded: macOS has no cgroups; one bash loop that mostly sleeps between git fetches, plus the ship-apk.sh / push.sh it runs (their docker builds and gates are bounded by their own containers)
